Changes to raylib in this repository

The source code of raylib is not changed, and neither are the macOS, Windows and Android libraries.

In device/libraylib.a, the build folder path stored in the compiled file (used only in the
messages of a few bundled headers) was replaced with a neutral path of the same length. Nothing
else in the file was changed.

Also in device/libraylib.a, raudio.c was compiled with -DMA_NO_PULSEAUDIO, so sound goes straight
to ALSA. Handhelds that run PipeWire can fail to open a playback device through its PulseAudio
layer. The source file itself is unchanged.
